incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert P0 - runtime container CrashLoopBackOff (segfault) in gpu-pool-us-west-2. Alert ID: PB-3123456789
Alex Chen: seeing a wave of crashloops on runtime-v2 pods, sigsegv in native kernel.
Priya Nair: I'm taking pager. Allocating 15m now. @Mateo can you grab telemetry and perf metrics?
Mateo Ruiz: pulling logs and node metrics. Quick summary: ~42 pods restarted in last 10m across 3 nodes. GPU mem usage normal pre-crash, no OOM killer entries.
Jordan Lee: logs show `SIGSEGV` in `libtrt_fused_kernel.so` during sequence generation. snippet:
``
2026-03-17T18:02:11Z runtime[pid=24321]: Received signal 11 (Segmentation fault)
#0  0x7f8c3ab1 in trt_fused_attn::compute(...) at trt_fused_attn.cpp:412
#1  0x7f8c3cd2 in runtime::execute_kernel(...) at runtime_engine.cpp:1291
```
Alex Chen: looks like the new fused-attn kernel rollout 2026-03-17T17:45 might be the trigger.
Priya Nair: immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon the 3 affected nodes, 2) scale down runtime-canary to 0, 3) route traffic away from GPU pool to dedicated-fallback (cpu-emu) on critical routes.
Mateo Ruiz: running commands now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-4 gpu-node-7 gpu-node-9` and `kubectl scale deployment/runtime-canary --replicas=0 -n inference`
Jordan Lee: uploading crash logs + core dumps to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incident-logs/3123456789/ (core.tar.gz, pod-logs/)
Alex Chen: collecting `gdb --batch -ex 'thread apply all bt' -p <pid>` output and attaching.
ops-bot: Alert: Rolling back image tag runtime:v2-fused-20260317 -> runtime:v2-fused-20260310 on edge-candidates. Deploy started.
Priya Nair: can we temporarily enable the old kernel path? env override `USE_FUSED_KERNEL=false` on runtime config? prefer rollback but env flip is faster.
Jordan Lee: applied `USE_FUSED_KERNEL=false` as env on the runtime daemonset in gpu-pool-us-west-2; new pods are coming up.
Mateo Ruiz: telemetry: error rate for text-generation routes spiked to ~9% 5xxs for customers using high-latency models, overall platform 5xx rate up to 2.4%. Largest affected customers: acme.ai (10% of their requests failing), Internal demo routes also impacted.
Kim Patel (customer-success): pinging CS on impacted customers. Reached out to Acme APM; they saw increased retries, no data loss but timeouts.
Alex Chen: collecting core dumps via `coredumpctl dump <unit> --output=core` and `gcore` where available. Note: need nvcr.io debug image to symbolicate.
Priya Nair: ETA for mitigation: rolled back canary and env flip complete. Observability: new pods are stable for ~60s.
Mateo Ruiz: after rollback, crashloop count dropped from 42 -> 1 (single flapping pod on node pending eviction). P95 latency back to baseline for most routes.
Jordan Lee: taking node offline: `kubectl drain gpu-node-9 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then provisioning replacement node.
Alex Chen: actionable follow-ups: 1) revert rollout in the release pipeline, 2) add extra unit/regression test for fused-attn edgecases, 3) run XR-runner fuzz on kernel inputs, 4) collect symbolicated stack traces and open bug in infra/engine repo.
Priya Nair: I'm handing pager to Mateo for the next shift. Mateo, will you take point for postmortem and customer RCA? :point_right:
Mateo Ruiz: taking it. I'll coordinate with Jordan for dump symbolication and with Kim for customer comms. Creating incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/3123456789
Alex Chen: note for release: pin quant-kernel to v20260310 until we have a fix. Also add a circuit-breaker so canary rollout doesn't exceed 5% of gpu pool if crashes detected.
incident-bot: Incident PB-3123456789 acknowledged by Priya Nair. Status: mitigation in progress.
Kim Patel: I'll draft an interim customer note: short blurb, impacted customers, mitigation steps, ETA for RCA. Will share in #customer-updates.
Mateo Ruiz: last check: 0.6% 5xx after rollback, cordoned nodes isolated. Saving final logs and closing immediate pager. I'll keep monitoring and will update incident doc with timeline + logs.
Priya Nair: handing off fully to Mateo. Logging final: `first_mitigated=3123456810` `closed_pager=3123456825`
Alex Chen: thanks all, major win for quick rollback. Follow-ups assigned in the incident doc.
